modalities.evidence: maternal respiration signal (through a resistive thoracic belt)

output.population: 60 entries from 39 voluntary pregnant women, between the 21st and the 27th week of gestation
output.summary: Open dataset of simultaneous non-invasive electrophysiological recordings, fetal pulsed-wave Doppler and maternal respiration signals, giving ground truth on fetal heart activity when an invasive scalp lead is unavailable.
